classification.difficultyReason: Combines supplementary and vertically opposite angles with the exterior angle theorem.

content.prompt: Determine all the missing angles in this diagram.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base, extended left side above the top vertex, and both intersecting lines extended at the bottom-right vertex. All five source angle arcs and labels are retained.
spec.mathematics: The exterior angle at the top is 126 degrees and is supplementary to a. The exterior angle of 42 degrees at the bottom-right is vertically opposite c. The exterior angle theorem gives b + c = 126 degrees. Coordinates preserve the source sketch proportions rather than asserting a scale drawing.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens 126 degrees and 42 degrees and unknown labels a, b and c are visible.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{align*}a&=180^{\circ}-126^{\circ}\\a&=54^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Vertically opposite angles are equal, so $c=42^{\circ}$.
By the exterior angle theorem,
$$\begin{align*}b+42^{\circ}&=126^{\circ}\\b&=84^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
